sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is a large mixture-of-experts model: 40 layers, 384 experts in each (6 are used for every word), and a 203 GB n-gram table next to them.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a sparse mixture-of-experts model built on the company's Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture, activating 8B parameters on input and 16B on output from a 552B-parameter backbone. It supports multimodal input (text and image) with a 1M-token context window and is positioned as the cost-efficient tier of the V4.1 family.
